title: Quantitative Stability of the Betke-Henk-Wills Conjecture
summary: The Betke-Henk-Wills conjecture proposes a sharp upper bound for the lattice point enumerator $G(K, Λ)$ of a convex body in terms of its successive minima. While the conjecture remains open for general convex bodies in dimensions $d \ge 5$, it is known to hold for orthogonal parallelotopes (boxes). In this paper, we establish the \textit{local stability} of the conjecture under small perturbations of the metric.
